games.name: Letter Search!
games.desc:
🔤 **Race to Find the Word!**

You have **1 minute and 30 seconds** to search the map, collect the right letters, and complete the challenge before everyone else!

Every letter you find joins your **letter train** and follows you as you race for the rest.

🎮 **3 Game Modes**
• **Find the Word** — Find every letter needed to complete the word!
• **Find the Letter** — Race to find the correct letter first!
• **Mystery Word** — Find the letters and figure out the hidden word as you go!

🛷 Unlock awesome **Hover Sleds**
✨ Collect and equip **Letter Skins**
🏆 Race other players to finish first
🔤 Build a huge train of letters behind you

**Search fast. Build your train. Find the word!**
